responsibility: This file implements GCC’s OpenMP/OpenACC offloading support outside the core lowering pass. It maintains the global offload_funcs and offload_vars tables used for host/device registration emission, discovers and classifies declare target entities and related references, interprets OpenACC routine/offload metadata such as execution dimensions, and contains device-specific GIMPLE lowering passes that rewrite SIMT/SIMD internal functions, resolve declare variant alternatives on device code, and handle "omp declare target link" variables by adjusting builtins and operand references for offloaded compilation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the offloading support declared in gcc/omp-offload.h, including the definitions of the global offload_funcs/offload_vars tables, declare-target discovery, offload table construction, and device-specific lowering passes such as ompdevlow and omp_target_link. Unlike the header, it contains the offload-analysis and device-rewrite algorithms rather than just the shared interface and globals.
